lines.translation: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sad dhoor ||
lines.translation: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadaa hajoor ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1||
Shabad:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pichhahu raatee sadaRaa naam khasam kaa lehi ||
lines.translation: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਮੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰਥ ਪੀੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kheme chhatr saraaiche disan rath peeRe ||
lines.translation: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jinee teraa naam dhiaaiaa tin kau sad mile ||1||
lines.translation: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||
Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na paaiaa teraa a(n)dhaa bharam bhoolaa man meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saad keete dukh paraphuRe poorab likhe maai ||
lines.translation: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sukh thoRe dukh agale dookhe dookh vihaai ||2||
lines.translation: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa veechhuRai miliaa kaa kiaa mel ||
lines.translation: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kar dekhiaa khel ||3||
lines.translation: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਇਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jogee melaavaRaa in tan keete bhog ||
lines.translation: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vijogee mil vichhuRe naanak bhee sa(n)jog ||4||1||
lines.translation: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, they may still be united once again! ||4||1||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.
The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.
According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.
Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||
O foolish mind, why are you so proud?
You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.
All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.
Eat some, and save the rest,
if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||
He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.
He issues all sorts of commands.
Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.
When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||
Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny.
